title: The Starless Choir
text: Voices sing out of nothing, a vast choir in a language that hurts the teeth and makes the ears ache. Each Scion hears a different song. Some of the songs are about them.

options.label: Listen to the choir, and learn what your song says.

outcomes.text: A song of home, and it teaches something.
A song of the end, and how it goes.

options.label: Hum over it, so you hear only your own tune.

outcomes.text: Your own tune, thin but yours, and the choir louder around it.

options.label: The wisest sings back, in whatever tongue they can.

outcomes.text: The choir falls silent, surprised, and the dark lets you through.
